properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for NPAs being bound to single application
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to validate non-personal/service accounts are bound to a single application within a specific environment, and managed (created, deployed, updated, and deleted) as part of the application lifecycle by the application owner.
